synopsis: Set out on an adventure as you color in Grogu, the Mandalorian, and other Star Wars characters in this coloring and activity book with 4 twistable crayons! In a galaxy far, far, away, there is one character who loves to snack: Grogu! Join Grogu and the Mandalorian on their many exciting adventures as they snack their way through this action-packed activity book! With coloring pages, puzzles, mazes, and galactic snacks, young fans will have a blast exploring the galaxy alongside their favorite little Force-sensitive character.
title: Grogu Loves to Snack!
